pairs = [
    (1000, "M"),
    (900, "CM"),
    (500, "D"),
    (400, "CD"),
    (100, "C"),
    (90, "XC"),
    (50, "L"),
    (40, "XL"),
    (10, "X"),
    (9, "IX"),
    (5, "V"),
    (4, "IV"),
    (1, "I"),
]
values = dict(zip("IVXLCDM", [1, 5, 10, 50, 100, 500, 1000]))
for n in [9, 14, 49, 94, 444, 1994, 2768, 3999]:
    remaining = n
    roman = ""
    for value, symbol in pairs:
        while remaining >= value:
            roman += symbol
            remaining -= value
    decoded = 0
    for i, symbol in enumerate(roman):
        value = values[symbol]
        decoded += (
            -value if i + 1 < len(roman) and value < values[roman[i + 1]] else value
        )
    print(f"{n} -> {roman} -> {decoded}")
